sources.description: The Jets have a new quarterback. It is an old quarterback. Geno Smith was reacquired from the Las Vegas Raiders at the start of the offseason. Smith was originally a Jet from 2013 through 2016. His four year tenure was tumultuous. Geno eventually found a home with the Seattle Seahawks before a rocky season in […]
